resources.string: Research assistant, phone control and AI model

Lets KGV X Intelligence read the screen and tap, type, swipe and take screenshots for you when you ask it to do something. It only acts while a task you started, or an MCP client you connected, is running.
Hi, I\'m KGV X Intelligence. Ask me to find and summarise articles on PubMed, build a literature review, or do something on your phone.
Ask or tell me to do something…
Listening… tap the mic to stop
Choose an AI model first: Settings › KGV X Intelligence.

Use the AI on your home PC: install llama.cpp, start it with llama-server -m Qwen3.5-4B.gguf --jinja --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8080 then tap Find my PC while the phone is on the same Wi-Fi. Nothing you ask leaves your home. Ollama (port 11434) and LM Studio (port 1234) work too.
Hundreds of hosted models with one key from openrouter.ai/keys. Pick one that supports tools; models with vision can read screenshots.

Up to four, separated by commas. The local resolver still caches and checks DNSSEC, and asks these servers instead of the root servers.

KGV FusionX runs its own DNS resolver (Unbound) on the phone. Every website lookup is answered by it, straight from the internet\'s root servers and checked with DNSSEC, instead of by your Wi-Fi owner, mobile network or a DNS company.
This network blocks it, so the network\'s own DNS is used for now. Try the encrypted mode or custom servers.
Lets MCP clients (a local agent in Termux, Claude Desktop or an IDE) use all these skills. Over USB: adb forward tcp:8765 tcp:8765.
